events.title: Miracle ticket
events.body: A kind stranger presses a miracle into your hand. “Someone didn’t show. Don’t ask questions.”

events.title: Flat tire
events.body: The beater lists hard. You’re on the shoulder swapping rubber in light you wouldn’t describe as legal.

events.title: Robbed
events.body: Someone rummaged while you slept at a rest stop. Your stash took a hit. The universe offers no receipt.

events.title: Hitchhiker with intel
events.body: A hitchhiker knows too much about tonight's venue. Trade some food and they'll whisper which song opens — you place your own bet later.

choices.label: Trade 1 food for the opener tip

events.title: Wook flu
events.body: Someone's wrecked — wook flu. One crew member catches it; if it isn't healed, 25% chance each turn someone else does. Camp and rest, power through, or hit a hotel.

events.title: Pulled over
events.body: Blue lights. The officer asks how many are in the vehicle and whether you know why you were weaving. Your crew goes quiet in that specific way.

events.title: Rest stop bathroom find
events.body: A baggie sits on the tile behind the toilet paper. Could be anything. Could be a federal case. Could be nothing.

events.title: Lot rumor
events.body: A lot elder swears they know a song landing in tonight's set. Trade a beer for the rumor — bet on it yourself if you believe them.

choices.label: Trade 1 beer for the setlist rumor

events.title: Wook whisper
events.body: A zonked regular offers encore intel for a taste of your stash. Tip only — you pick the bet.

choices.label: Trade 1 substance for the encore tip

events.title: Rest stop dog
events.body: A golden retriever in a tie-dye bandana approaches the van with the confidence of someone who's done this before. Everyone's morale improves.

events.title: Wrong exit
events.body: Someone read the map upside down. You ended up at a Cracker Barrel 40 miles east. Nobody's mad. Nobody's apologizing either.

events.title: Speedrun trucker
events.body: An 18-wheeler with 'HONK IF YOU LOVE THE JAM' stenciled on the back drafts you for 60 miles. The van's never felt faster.

events.title: Toll booth moment
events.body: The toll collector leans out, looks at your crew, and says 'Nice. Have a good show.' You didn't tell them where you were going.

events.title: Radio find
events.body: Somewhere between two corn states, a college station plays three of their songs back to back. The crew sings every word.

events.title: Gas station prophet
events.body: A man pumping diesel tells you the encore is always the one you don't expect. You write it on a napkin. You lose the napkin.

events.title: Drive-through score
events.body: A roadside stand sells breakfast burritos out of a cooler. Someone orders for everyone. Nobody complains.

events.title: Speeding ticket
events.body: The officer was not impressed by your explanation. The fine is not negotiable. The vibes take a hit.

events.title: Lot connection at the pump
events.body: Guy at the next pump recognizes a sticker on the van. Ends up trading two beers and some directions for a gas top-up.

events.title: Van hiccup
events.body: The van shudders, backfires twice, then continues. Everyone silently agrees not to mention it.
